decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical BIOS data interface.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS MSBIO1 defines In_Bios and includes msbdata.inc; DOS MSDATA and COMMAND INIT also include it for fixed-address interface declarations.
Prior MSBIO1 review places its BIOS_DATA contribution at IO.SYS offset 1446.
The ten bytes corresponding to DosDataSg, bios_i2f, romstartaddr and altah at file offset 0x5A9 in a saved BIOS build match target IO.SYS byte for byte.
limitations: This directly checks the selected disk-DOS BIOS layout only; ROMDOS branches and final linked segment or pointer values require separate verification. Complete core binary identity remains unverified.
